title: Retro's Cherry Tools and More
body:
![Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/087d840650df86ac4a2b9420bcdf2a85eb5f1e06.png)

# **Ever wanted wanted to have cherry tools and armor? Just me? ok...**

This mod adds a new "ore" item. Cherry Crystals! The cherry crystal is a new type of ore that can only be crafted. (Like Netherite) It is slightly better than diamonds (but not better than Netherite). this mod aims to help casual players who still struggle upgrading to netherite but still want a new upgrade.

 - All textures were made to follow the vanilla textures for minecraft. Some textures may change in the future as updates roll out.
